title: Clothing, Activity and Human Metabolism
description: Human metabolism at low and high activity with different levels of clothing. Calculate comfort temperature and heat transfer based on activity level, clothing insulation, and relative air speed.

components.content: Calculate human metabolism parameters based on activity level and clothing insulation.

outputs.label: Comfort Temperature
outputs.formula: inputs.activity_level === 'sitting' ? (inputs.clothing_insulation === 0 ? 28.8 : inputs.clothing_insulation === 0.3 ? 30.1 : inputs.clothing_insulation === 0.5 ? 30.7 : inputs.clothing_insulation === 1.0 ? 31.4 : 32.0) : inputs.activity_level === 'medium' ? (inputs.clothing_insulation === 0 ? 24.4 : inputs.clothing_insulation === 0.3 ? 26.2 : inputs.clothing_insulation === 0.5 ? 27.1 : inputs.clothing_insulation === 1.0 ? 28.2 : 29.0) : (inputs.clothing_insulation === 0 ? 22.1 : inputs.clothing_insulation === 0.5 ? 23.4 : inputs.clothing_insulation === 1.0 ? 24.9 : 25.5)

outputs.label: Convection
outputs.formula: inputs.activity_level === 'sitting' ? (inputs.clothing_insulation === 0 ? 36 : inputs.clothing_insulation === 0.3 ? 40 : inputs.clothing_insulation === 0.5 ? 40 : inputs.clothing_insulation === 1.0 ? 40 : 40) : inputs.activity_level === 'medium' ? (inputs.clothing_insulation === 0 ? 59 : inputs.clothing_insulation === 0.3 ? 115 : inputs.clothing_insulation === 0.5 ? 115 : inputs.clothing_insulation === 1.0 ? 115 : 115) : (inputs.clothing_insulation === 0 ? 107 : inputs.clothing_insulation === 0.5 ? 192 : inputs.clothing_insulation === 1.0 ? 192 : 192)

outputs.label: Radiation
outputs.formula: inputs.activity_level === 'sitting' ?
